_doc: The Tour (THPS career; src/sim/game/tour.ts, docs/mechanics/tour.md): every level open from the start (docs/open-world.md: the neighbourhoods' open challenges, started from each level's marker in the city), played as runs of seconds (`run level <id> [start]`). Each level: world (soma or sf), a start spot (spot; starts: other spots a run may start from), area [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] (more than wrongWay.away metres outside it: event levelWrongWay, a hint, never a fail; back within wrongWay.back: levelBack), S-K-A-T-E letters (pos x, y, z: passed within data run.letterRadius), a secret tape (pos: found within tapeRadius), score tiers (pro, sick) and its own goals. A level's goal list is pro, sick, skate (all five letters), tape (names below) and its goals. Goal kinds: gap (any of gaps, ids in data/gaps.json), skitch (towed meters in one skitch; robo), speed (kmh inside box, within z), combo (a combo of points, started inside box when given; with gaps, holding one of them; with tricks, holding one of these trick ids, e.g. spine), grind (one grind at least meters long, inside box when given). worlds: other worlds a level can be played in (the park is inside sf too). areas: more boxes of the same level (the wrong-way hint is measured from the nearest); exclude: boxes inside them that are not this level (a spot of another level: the hint shows in them at once). Goal kinds also: air (an air of at least seconds taken off inside box), dash (from the from box into the to box within seconds); a combo with every holds all of its gaps.
